name: label-printer
description: Print labels from Claude Code on Brother QL and P-touch label printers on Linux. Discovers printers over mDNS, USB and CUPS and keeps a machine-local registry so later prints can name one; renders text and QR labels to the pixel canvas of the loaded DK or TZe media; previews without touching the printer, because brother_ql converts and transmits in a single step with no dry run. Ships a media catalogue of DK and TZe product codes, reusable label templates in the user's data directory, and a Linux driver-install skill covering brother_ql, ptouch-print, mDNS and CUPS. Zebra and DYMO are discovered and registered but not yet printable. Also bundles the original streamable-HTTP MCP server for P-touch setups built around a USB print bridge.
